Package ru.nsu.tsydenov

Class Dealer

java.lang.Object
ru.nsu.tsydenov.Player
ru.nsu.tsydenov.Dealer
public class Dealer extends Player
Represents the dealer in a Blackjack game.

Extends Player and manages dealing cards from a Deck, revealing the hidden face-down card ("hole card"), and following standard dealer drawing rules.
